properties.error_model: Never silent. The contract is that stripping is SAID OUT LOUD — a caller must be told what was removed, because a boundary that cleans text without reporting it leaves the reader believing they saw the original.
properties.name: Ingress trust boundary — foreign text is stripped of hidden instructions, and the stripping is said out loud
properties.operations: sanitize(foreign_text) -> cleaned text + what was removed
properties.payload_schema: crates/reflow2-core/src/sanitize.rs — three documented smuggling channels: Unicode tag characters (U+E0001, U+E0020–U+E007F), and the other classes the module enumerates. Technique imported from github-mcp-server's pkg/sanitize.
